name: Kaitou Akyua ~Kutsujoku no Matsuro~
original_name: 怪盗アキュア 〜屈辱の末路〜
source:
Aki is your average officer worker by day and... Phantom Thief Aqua by night!

She only accepts high rewarding jobs and today, one such request has been made of her. What she didn't know is that it was a dastardly trap set up by her client to capture her...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ197775.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
亚希白天是普通的军官，晚上则是……怪盗阿克娅！

她只接受高报酬的工作，而今天，有人向她提出了这样的要求。她不知道的是，这是她的委托人为抓捕她而设下的卑鄙陷阱……

[来自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ197775.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英语[/url]]
